analysis.insight_summary: Forum users reported that some Cyrillic (Russian) letters do not appear as intended on the [product_name] text display hardware. While computer simulation displays the text correctly, the actual device renders certain symbols incorrectly, hinting at a character encoding or compatibility issue between the software and hardware, affecting multilingual support.
